description: An object type naming an attribute twice is an error
notes: The README doesn't say what an object type constructor that names an attribute twice means, and the spec doesn't say what an object constructor with duplicate keys does (native/collections/object-duplicate-key-last-wins): object types can't have two attributes with the same name, but hashicorp/hcl evaluates such a constructor by keeping the last value. getType (ext/typeexpr/get_type.go) reports the second name as an error.
reference_error: Object constructor map keys must be unique
